therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Immune system enhancement combined with radiation-induced immunogenic cell death
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Abscopal effect - systemic immune response against distant metastases following local radiation
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Proportion of patients with abscopal response at 7-8 weeks

results.dose_information: Thymalfasin given twice weekly with 3-4 day intervals; Radiation 3.5Gy per fraction, total 35Gy over 10 fractions in 2 weeks

context.duration: Treatment over 2 weeks, follow-up to 2 years
